title: People’s Mañanera October 19
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Nearly 20 Million Students Receive Wellbeing Stipends  
** With an investment of 136.9 billion pesos (US$7.61 billion), 19.5 million
students are benefiting, and the program is expected to reach 22 million
recipients by 2026. President Claudia Sheinbaum reaffirmed that “we care about
young people; we want them to be in school.”

**Chihuahua: National Sovereignty Is Non-Negotiable  
** The President reported that the Federal Attorney General’s Office (FGR) is
investigating former Chihuahua prosecutor César Jáuregui for alleged treason,
following an unauthorized operation with U.S. agents. She reiterated that no
foreign intervention may take place outside the scope of Mexican law.

**Mexico Will Demand Justice for the Death of a Mexican National in ICE
Custody  
** The President announced that Mexico will file a complaint in the U.S.
government to clear up the circumstances involving the death of a Mexican
national detained by ICE. Sheinbaum reaffirmed that “our solidarity and
affection are always with Mexicans abroad.”

**Morena Reaches 45% in Opinion Polls  
** The President pointed to a poll showing Morena with 45% voter support,
compared to 8% for the conservative National Action Party (PAN), ahead of the
federal congressional elections.
